title: Fortnite Slurp Juice
blurb: Blue, fizzy and gone in a few glugs. Slurp Juice trickles health and shields back into you over time rather than all at once, so drinking it mid-fight is a bet that nobody is about to peek your position. The audio is pure Fortnite design: cartoonish, readable across a hundred metres, and instantly familiar to anyone who has crouched behind a wall counting to ten. It has become the standard joke sound for taking a swig of anything — energy drinks especially.
origin: The Slurp Juice consumable sound from Fortnite.
